title: Florida House, District 67
what_it_does: Represents District 67 (Part of Hillsborough) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Lisette Bonano
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Retired U.S. Army lieutenant colonel who describes herself as a mother, soldier and leader. Her campaign lists affordability, property-tax relief, insurance reform, parental rights, school choice, border security and support for police as priorities.

property_tax.summary: Asked what policies she would pursue to help with the cost of living, Bonano answered in full: eliminate residential property taxes.

candidates.name: Luis Viera
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Attorney and Florida Bar-certified mediator; Tampa City Council member (District 7) resigning Nov. 2, 2026
candidates.background: Lifelong Tampa resident who has represented New Tampa and North Tampa on the Tampa City Council for nearly a decade, chairing its public safety committee and the Hillsborough Area Regional Transit Authority board. An attorney and mediator, he founded the Lawyers Autism Awareness Foundation. He resigned his council seat effective Nov. 2, 2026 to run for HD 67 and is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Fentrice Driskell.

property_tax.summary: WMNF reports his stance on property taxes as 'mend it, don't end it,' favoring accommodations for seniors rather than elimination.
